spans.value: approximately seven times the odds of admission

edges.label: supports
edges.reason: Both quotes state that Black applicants had approximately seven times the odds of admission compared to otherwise equivalent white applicants for the 2025 class, citing the DOJ.

edges.label: supports
edges.reason: Both statements report that the DOJ found Hispanic applicants had approximately twice the odds of admission. They are independent reports of the same DOJ finding.

edges.sentence: On 2026-10-01, Reuters reported “Hispanic applicants had two times the odds of getting in that year, the Justice Department said.”; on 2026-10-02, USA Today reported “For Hispanic applicants, their odds of admission were approximately two times that of “otherwise white equivalent applicants,” the DOJ said.”.

On 2026-10-01, Reuters reported “In 2025, Black applicants had seven times the odds of being admitted compared to “otherwise equivalent” white applicants, the letter said.”; on 2026-10-02, USA Today reported “Black applicants “had approximately seven times the odds of admission” to the law school compared to its “otherwise equivalent white applicants” for the 2025 incoming class, according to the DOJ.”.
